title: RWB-S6-E6010-APP: the closure slice has no plan row for its four consumed contracts, no published closure operation, an open-action set no source enumerates, no right for an unattended step and an ALS and GL integration point it does not own
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R7.3 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S6-E6010-APP; context pack S6 rwb-debtsale (service row, ownership rows, Architecture v5 slides 3, 4, 5, 8 and 13, Temporal and Drools slides 5, 12 and 13); legacy RWB-E6-010; FSD S6 Debt sale v3 A2.14 and the requirements served; Recovery Workbench Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 row FEAT-DBS-14; TSD S6 Debt sale v2 T2, T3.1 to T3.3, T4, T5.2, T5.3, T6.1, T6.2 and T-A; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DS-23, R-UNI-47 and the state table rows CASE_CLOSED_SOLD and ANY_ACTIVE
description: (1) The plan gives H = RWB-S6-E6010-CON, RWB-PLT-E1027-CON and RWB-PLT-N001-CON with C, I and X empty, while the step reads rwb-case (case state and open actions), answers the rwb-case closure, calls rwb-access for the right and reads the rwb-decision package, so four consumed rows have no plan row and the operation names of the closure answer and of the authorise call appear in no source. (2) TSD S6 appendix T-A publishes five operations and none is a case closure; the single endpoint row of the legacy story, POST /api/recovery/v1/debt-sale-lots/{lotId}/award, is API-S6-003, which is the award story's RWB-S6-E6005-APP, so this slice publishes no operation of its own. (3) Both the FSD (A2.14.1) and R-UNI-47 say only 'stop every open action'; no source enumerates the set of open actions, tasks, timers, deviations or stage children to be stopped, nor which service stops each. (4) The FSD makes the feature unattended (A2.14.3.3, 'None; runs unattended'), the legacy permission table gives Debt sale right A to RW-DEBTSALE, RW-PRODHEAD and RW-HEADASL, and TSD S6 T6.1 gives the service identities SY-CASEWF, SY-RULES and SY-AGENT the right R only, so no right covers the unattended closure itself. (5) The integration points of FEAT-DBS-14 read 'Workbench, ALS and GL', while the ALS derecognition and the general ledger posting are R-DS-30 and R-DS-31 of FEAT-DBS-12 in RWB-S6-E6008-APP, and this step holds no adapter, no posting and no balance. (6) The legacy Data table names recovery_case, decision_log_entry and rule_row, none of which this service may read or write, and the legacy base /api/recovery/v1 is not the per-service base. (7) The split plan carries no requirement id for this slice although REQ-S6-007 states the requirement.
evidence: split plan slice RWB-S6-E6010-APP with three H rows and empty C, I and X; Template and Rules v1 R5.4 classes C and H, R5.5 DP-01, DP-03, DP-08 and DP-13, and R5.6 wave map; context pack ownership rows (debt_sale_lot and debt_sale_account, S6; five REST operations; event EV-23; workflow DebtSaleWorkflow) and connection-matrix row S6 Debt sale; FSD S6 A2.14.1 to A2.14.4.4; Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 row FEAT-DBS-14 (primary role 'Runs unattended', integration points 'Workbench, ALS and GL', prerequisite FEAT-DBS-09); TSD S6 T2, T3.1 to T3.3, T6.1 and T-A.1; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DS-23, R-DS-29, R-DS-30, R-DS-31 and R-UNI-47 and the state table rows CASE_CLOSED_SOLD and ANY_ACTIVE; legacy RWB-E6-010 Data, Endpoints, Screen and states, Permission checks and Acceptance criteria
area: Dependency, ownership, permission and integration trace
legacy_ref: RWB-E6-010 (sections 2, 4, 7, 11 and 18 of the new story)
proposed: Keep the plan's H, C, I and X rows as they stand; record the rwb-case, rwb-access and rwb-decision rows as class C in fact with their placeholders; declare no provided operation and name API-S6-003 of RWB-S6-E6005-APP as the signal that starts the step; apply 'every open action' on the owners' boundaries through the closure answer and record the set as an assumption; run the unattended step under the rwb-debtsale service identity and keep the Debt sale A right with the three human roles on the award and the element read; declare no adapter and leave the ALS derecognition and the ledger posting with RWB-S6-E6008-APP; adopt REQ-S6-007 for traceability

title: RWB-S6-E6010-CON: the closure baseline has no published closure operation or closure element schema, no plan row for its four consumed contracts, no operation names for the case read, the closure answer or the authorise call, and no right for the unattended step
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R7.2 s12, R7.3 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S6-E6010-CON; context pack S6 rwb-debtsale (service row, ownership rows, naming rules); legacy RWB-E6-010; FSD S6 Debt sale v3 A2.14; Recovery Workbench Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 row FEAT-DBS-14; TSD S6 Debt sale v2 T2, T3.1 to T3.3, T4, T6.1 and T-A; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DS-23 and R-UNI-47 and the state table row CASE_CLOSED_SOLD
description: (1) The plan gives no C, I or X row while the baseline declares four consumed rows (the rwb-case case read, the rwb-case closure answer, the rwb-access authorise call and the rwb-decision package read), so the contract dependencies of this slice exist in fact and not in the plan. (2) TSD S6 T-A publishes five operations and none is a case closure, and no source publishes a closure element schema, so the element, its property set and its required flags are a design choice of the baseline while the end state and the list values are not. (3) The operation names of the case read, the closure answer and the authorise call appear in no source and must stay placeholders until their owners publish them. (4) The end state CASE_CLOSED_SOLD is a row of the UNIVERSAL route set and R-UNI-47 is a universal rule, while the closure feature is an S6 feature, so the baseline names both packages and declares neither. (5) The FSD makes the feature unattended while the legacy permission row holds Debt sale right A for three human roles and TSD S6 T6.1 gives the service identities the right R, so the rights are fixed per surface and not per step. (6) The integration points of FEAT-DBS-14 name ALS and GL while the derecognition and the posting are rules of FEAT-DBS-12, so the baseline declares no adapter and no posting. (7) The split plan carries no requirement id for this slice although REQ-S6-007 states the requirement.
evidence: split plan slice RWB-S6-E6010-CON with empty C, I and X; Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5 DP-03, DP-13 and DP-19, R7.2 s12 and R9; context pack service row (schema rwb_debtsale, base /api/recovery/debtsale/v1, topic rwb.debtsale.events.v1, queue rwb-debtsale) and ownership rows (two tables, five REST operations, event EV-23, workflow DebtSaleWorkflow); FSD S6 A2.14.1 to A2.14.4.4; Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 row FEAT-DBS-14; TSD S6 T3.1, T3.2, T4, T6.1 and T-A.1; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DS-23, R-DS-30, R-DS-31, R-UNI-47 and the state table row CASE_CLOSED_SOLD; legacy RWB-E6-010 Endpoints, Permission checks, Screen and states and Test cases
legacy_ref: RWB-E6-010 (contract tables and sections 7, 12 and 18 of the new contract story)
proposed: Declare no provided operation and record API-S6-003 of RWB-S6-E6005-APP as the signal that starts the step; declare the closure element as a read-only element embedded in the lot read answer and the composite route, with its property set and required flags settled in the baseline review; keep the four consumed rows with their placeholders and their owner documents; fix the end state and the four lists as published enumerations and the rights per surface; declare no adapter and no posting; adopt REQ-S6-007 for traceability
